headline: Cat Accidentally Thrown Out With Couch Rescued at Landfill
meta_description: A family's beloved cat was accidentally discarded with their couch but was miraculously found and rescued at the landfill.
summary_short: A cat accidentally thrown out with a couch was discovered and rescued at a landfill, then reunited with its relieved family.
body:
A family's cat has been rescued after an extraordinary mishap—the animal was accidentally thrown out with their couch and ended up at a landfill. Despite the harrowing circumstances, the cat was found alive at the waste facility and returned to its owners.

The incident reveals how quickly a beloved pet can disappear in a moment of confusion during disposal or moving day. What could have been a tragedy became a rescue story thanks to discovery at the landfill, where workers or responders spotted the animal among discarded items.

The reunion with the family offers a reminder of both the fragility of pet safety during household transitions and the compassion of those who work at waste facilities. The case was shared widely on social media, resonating with pet owners everywhere who understand how precious these moments of recovery truly are.
